key_insight: A 7-qubit NV-center spin register can achieve near-threshold, high-fidelity two-qubit gates through careful crosstalk-aware optimization.
engineering_relevance: This advances solid-state quantum network nodes toward scalable distributed quantum computing by showing multi-qubit control with fidelities suitable for fault-tolerant architectures.
method: Built a 7-qubit register from nuclear spins coupled to a diamond NV center
Analyzed and mitigated crosstalk in a highly connected spin system
Optimized and verified gates using gate set tomography
evidence_signal: The reported two-qubit gate fidelities reached 99.61(5)% best and 99.18(2)% on average, and the register was demonstrated in a VQE simulation of H2 and LiH.
watch_item: The results are promising but still depend on precise control in a highly connected multi-qubit device, where crosstalk and scaling overhead remain implementation challenges.
paper_title: High-fidelity two-qubit gates in a 7-qubit register for quantum networks
